claim.claim-text: 1. A power module semiconductor device comprising:

2. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 2, wherein the first semiconductor chips (Q4) and the second semiconductor chips (Q1) are located at a position apart from one another in planar view observed from a thickness direction of the insulating substrate (10).

3. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 1, further comprising a first source sense terminal (S4) disposed so as to be extended in the vertical direction, the first source sense terminal being electrically connected to the first semiconductor chips (Q4).

4. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 1, further comprising a second source sense terminal (S1) disposed so as to be extended in the vertical direction, the second source sense terminal being electrically connected to the second semiconductor chips (Q1).

5. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 3, wherein the first source sense terminal (S4) and the first gate signal terminal (G4) are linearly disposed on the second main surface of the resin layer.

6. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 4, wherein the second source sense terminal (S1) and the second gate signal terminal (G1) are linearly disposed on the second main surface of the resin layer.

7. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 3, wherein the first source sense terminal (S4) and the first gate signal terminal (G4) are disposed in a zigzag on the second main surface of the resin layer.

8. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 4, wherein the second source sense terminal (S1) and the second gate signal terminal (G1) are disposed in a zigzag on the second main surface of the resin layer.

9. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 2, wherein the first semiconductor chips (Q4) and the second semiconductor chips (Q1) are any one of a SiC based power device, a GaN based power device and an AlN based power device.
10. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 1, further comprising:

thermistor connecting terminals (B1, B2) located on the insulating substrate (10) and disposed so as to be extended in the vertical direction, and a thermistor connected to between the thermistor connecting terminals (B1, B2).

11. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 2, wherein the first pattern (D(K4)) and the first semiconductor chips (Q4) are bonded by a first soldering layer, and the second pattern (D(K1)) and the second semiconductor chips (Q1) are bonded by a second soldering layer.

12. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 2, wherein the first pattern (D(K4)) and the first semiconductor chip (Q4) are bonded by an annealing paste material containing conductive particles, and the second pattern (D(K1)) and the second semiconductor chip (Q1) are bonded by an annealing paste material containing conductive particles.

13. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 12, wherein the conductive particles are metallic fine particles which are silver particles, gold particles, nickel particles, or copper particles.

14. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 1, wherein the first side surface of the resin layer has a recessed part between the negative side power input terminal (N) and the positive side power input terminal (P) in planar view observed from the vertical direction.
15. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 2, further comprising:

a first source sense terminal (S4) disposed so as to be extended in the vertical direction, the first source sense terminal being electrically connected to the first semiconductor chips (Q4); and a second source sense terminal (S1) disposed so as to be extended in the vertical direction, the second source sense terminal being electrically connected to the second semiconductor chips (Q1), wherein the first semiconductor chips (Q4) and the second semiconductor chips (Q1) are any one of a SiC based power device, a GaN based power device and an AlN based power device.

16. The power module semiconductor device according to 15, wherein the first side surface of the resin layer has a recessed part between the negative side power input terminal (N) and the positive side power input terminal (P) in planar view observed from the vertical direction.
17. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 16, further comprising:

thermistor connecting terminals (B1, B2) located on the insulating substrate (10) and disposed so as to be extended in the vertical direction, and a thermistor connected to between the thermistor connecting terminals (B1, B2).

18. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 17, wherein the first pattern (D(K4)) and the first semiconductor chip (Q4) are bonded by an annealing paste material containing conductive particles, and the second pattern (D(K1)) and the second semiconductor chip (Q1) are bonded by an annealing paste material containing conductive particles.

19. The power module semiconductor device according to claim 18, wherein the conductive particles are metallic fine particles which are silver particles, gold particles, nickel particles, or copper particles.
